To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Moroccan economy is characterized by the existence of business cycles.
the economic growth in Morocco, since 1958, is characterized by a tendency to grow and a conjunctural fluctuations.
the Moroccan economy has been characterized by a high volatility and a high degree of persistence in the growth rate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of Moroccan economy in the context of the international economic and financial crises.
the study of the conjuncture fluctuations and the long-term growth of the Moroccan economy.
the Moroccan economy, the economic conjuncture, and the business cycle, and the effects of economic policies on the Moroccan economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Moroccan economy is still in a process of catching-up and that the economic cycles are still a major challenge for the country’s economic policy.
the economic conjuncture is the main determinant of the Moroccan economy.
the GDP-cycles of the Moroccan economy are relatively more sensitive to economic conjuncture and international environment, especially of main partners.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Moroccan economy has been characterized by the existence of a business cycle of 8-9 years.
the Moroccan economic growth is characterized by an alternation of periods of strong growth and periods of slowdown.
the Moroccan economy has experienced a long-term growth of 5.5% per year.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GDP-Cycles are a useful and relevant tool for economic analysis, policy-making and economic forecasting.
the Moroccan economy has experienced a long period of growth, with some slowdown in the 1990s and a strong recovery in the 2000s.
the Moroccan economy, despite its structural reforms and the economic openness, is still subject to the economic cycles, and therefore to the economic shocks.
